For iOS I play x2048 a lot. It is like 2048 but more fun and challenging, since it uses a hexagonal board. And it is free.

JellyCar is an old platformeresque arcade game. It might not be new, but it has relatively fresh aspects you might consider appealing. As the name suggests, you maneuver a red gelatin car though obstacles of varying difficulty to complete each level.

Desert Golfing - The perfect mobile game. No fancy high scores, no pat on the back for getting a hole in one... just put the ball in the hole and move on. Plus I'm pretty sure the levels are infinite.

Puzzle & Dragon is pretty fun. It is a match 3, monster raising, dungeon crawler RPG. It just got a version released on 3DS if you don't want to deal with the freemium stuff like energy limitations.

Groove Coaster/GC Zero is another good game (iOS only). It is a rhythm game similar to DJ hero, but with Japanese Dance and Techno music. It's a really good little time waster, and they made sure that most of the songs are fairly short to make playing on the go easier.

Final Fantasy Record Keeper is the other game I've been playing on mobile recently. It is sorta a Greatest Hits of Final Fantasy dungeons and battles and is surprisingly faithful to the original games it is based on.

Where are you from?

I live just outside of Johannesburg, a major African business hub. I live in a suburb.

What's it like there?

Where I am it's quite alright. I have plans to move as there are no opportunities here for someone who pursues the career that I desire. The internet isn't really first-class and the electricity providers have so many problems that we experience planned power cuts (we call it loadshedding) multiple times a week. There aren't any major problems that directly affect me here but a lot of annoying inconveniences. A lot of the urban culture is annoying. It's like a third-rate version of American pop culture. It's awful.
Where do you plan on moving and what field are you going in?

I'm deciding at the moment but most probably Canada. Music, meaning there are precisely fuck-all opportunities for me anywhere. English-teaching is also a point of interest for me though. I happen to be good at a bunch of things that are terrible ways to make money.
Well good luck to you in your endeavors.
How is it going there after Mr. Mandela passing? Are you guys still talking about him, is the spirit of his legacy still there?

We still talk about him. I'm sure he will never be forgotten. His legacy lives on in many ways. A lot of people vote for the political party that's currently in control of the country (the ANC) because they believe they owe it to Nelson Mandela since he was a member. I personally beg to differ strongly. I feel that electing a party based on who's policies one thinks are most beneficial towards the country is the best way to keep his legacy alive. He would want what was best for this country.

The most common cause for out of round holes is a wrongly ground drill bit. When you grind une shoulder of the bit longer than the other it would cause the bit to wobble in the hole.

Other than that you need to check the bearings, the chuck and the chuck taper; worn jaws etc. Also you may need to tighten the quill if it has worked itself loose.

I recently bought a new chinese drill press and it had most of these problems right from the factory.
